propositions: Op-cert service performs per-job boto3/SSM/region lookup and patches process-global key/principal/push state, coupling app config to one secret store and creating concurrency/cleanup hazards

Startup binding must accept exactly one of REBAR_OPCERT_KEY_PATH or REBAR_OPCERT_PRIVATE_KEY, validate before queue/worker/network/workspace creation, and copy to a process-owned 0700/0600 directory/file for one immutable signer

Both out-of-opcert_service/ producer chains (completion and plan-review signing) must thread an optional context-local OpcertSigner binding through sign_manifest, _sign_manifest_under_lock, and mint_opcert_record, replacing per-job os.environ reads

Op-cert application runtime must remove all SSM/boto3/region/key-parameter dependencies: compose service carries no key-retrieval config, image needs no runtime boto3, and key is materialized before start by fetch-secrets.sh to a 0600 read-only mounted file

Process-owned copy must remain stable for lifetime, observe replacement only after restart, cleanup only the copy (never the deployment source), and concurrent/timed-out jobs must prove context-local isolation with immutable startup signer
Concurrent and timed-out jobs must use distinct principals/policies and prove context isolation, immutable startup signer, and no workspace push remote
